events.title: The Rule of the Templars approved at Troyes
events.shortBlurb: A council at Troyes gave the young order of the Knights Templar its rule, launching the first of the military orders…
body: At the Council of Troyes, which met in January 1129, the Church gave formal approval and a written rule to the Knights of the Temple, the brotherhood founded some years earlier to guard pilgrims on the roads of the Holy Land. St. Bernard of Clairvaux, the most influential churchman of the age, lent the new order his powerful support and helped shape its rule.

With this recognition the Templars became the first of the great military religious orders, men who were both monks and knights, vowed to poverty, chastity, and obedience yet bearing arms in defense of Christendom. The order grew enormously in wealth and reputation before its suppression nearly two centuries later.
